evidence.role: Executes settlement (if needed), ticket burn, state updates, and prize/quote delivery in a single non-try/catch call frame; reverts on transferFrom failure, post-transfer ownerOf != winner (PrizeDeliveryVerificationFailed), or _transferQuote failure.
Screens destination for protocol addresses (reverting with InvalidQuoteDestination) and transfers quoteToken via SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Bubbles any revert from quoteToken.transfer and reverts with SafeERC20FailedOperation if transfer returns false or targets a code-less address.

reasoning: implemented (and not partial) because redeemWinningTicket is the sole redemption entrypoint, restricts execution to Status.NftWon and Status.CashWon (Raffle.sol:L312), and executes all state writes (_settleWinningTicket, winnerRecipient, winnerRedeemed, _burn, prizeClaimed, winnerProceeds) in the same transaction frame as delivery without any try/catch. On Status.NftWon, both prizeToken.transferFrom (Raffle.sol:L334) and the post-transfer prizeToken.ownerOf(deliveredPrizeTokenId) != winner check (Raffle.sol:L335-L337) revert the transaction on failure; on Status.CashWon, _transferQuote and SafeERC20.safeTransfer (Raffle.sol:L342,L564-L567; SafeERC20.sol:L33-L37,L176-L200) revert the transaction on invalid destination, subcall revert, or false return.
